references.name: [d2] HAER WA-210 sheet 2, USS Turner Joy (DD-951), inboard profile and upper deck plans
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Inboard Profile and Upper Deck Plans - USS Turner Joy, Bremerton Marina, Bremerton, Kitsap County, WA HAER WA-210 (sheet 2 of 4).png' (HAER, public domain), read by the 2026 builder; not cached here (Commons returned 429 to this batch's fetches)
references.note: Scale: the 407 ft 5 in waterline bar. The sheer, keel, stem, deck-edge plan, deckhouse outline, stacks and gun stations. Turner Joy is an SCB 85A ship with later deckhouse enlargements, so only the hull lines and the stations are taken from it. Kept as 'quarter' (no outline gated) until a builder caches it and sets crop, scale and origin.

must_show: a transom stern, rounded in plan
mount 51, a single 5-inch/54 Mk 42 in a boxy gunhouse with two round sight hoods, on the forecastle at x 39.6 (node turret)
mount 52 superfiring on the 01 deck at x -32.6 and mount 53 on the main deck at x -46.0, both trained aft, barrels inside the fantail
two twin 3-inch/50 Mk 33: one in the rounded tub at the fore end of the 01 deck at x 29.0, one on the 01 deck at x -22.6 pointing aft
two tall oval stacks raked aft with black caps: the forward one x 10.3 .. 8.6 to z 16.5, the after one x -7.6 .. -8.8 to z 14.5

the tripod foremast at x 13.4 straddling the forward stack, a broad yard, the SPS-6 bedspring on its forward platform at z 23.6 .. 25.7 and the SPS-10 at the masthead z 26.75; the shorter after tripod at x -4.8 to z 21.8 with yards and a small radome can
the long main-deck deckhouse from x -38.8 (tapered after end) to x 32.9, walkways outboard of it
the bridge block on the 01 deck, front at x 26.1 .. 25.0, two levels with rounded fronts, round ports in the pilot house, the open bridge and the forward director at x 18.6
the after director on its own house x -17.6 .. -12.4 abaft the after stack
two Hedgehogs on the 01 deck at x 26.1, y +-3.35, either side of the forward 3-inch, four rows of six spigots
four single 21-inch torpedo tubes amidships on the 01 deck at x -0.6 and 2.4, y +-3.4, trained outboard
a 26-ft motor whaleboat in davits each side at x -13.9, y +-5.15
lifelines along every exposed deck edge, bitts and fairleads, hatches, ventilators, a ready-service locker by mount 52, oblong life floats on the deckhouse sides, the anchors in hawses at x 56.6

how the four 21-inch tubes lay on the 01 deck: no photograph used shows them; d2's later Mk 32 site is used

the batch-4 deck fittings (fairleads, forecastle and fantail hatches, mushroom ventilators, the ready-service locker by mount 52, life floats on the house sides): placed by proportion, not one by one off a photograph
